title: Pool swimming length
description: One active or idle pool length recorded within a swimming activity.

lengthIndex.description: The zero-based length order within the activity.

timestamp.description: The length message time in ISO 8601 format.

startTime.description: The length start time in ISO 8601 format.

elapsedTimeSeconds.description: The elapsed length duration in seconds.

timerTimeSeconds.description: The active length duration in seconds.

averageSpeedMetersPerSecond.description: The average speed in meters per second.

averageCadenceStrokesPerMinute.description: The average swimming cadence in strokes per minute.

caloriesKilocalories.description: The estimated energy expenditure in kilocalories.

lengthType.description: Whether the length is active or idle.
